authorized_by: User: có, miễn làm sao cho PF có IDSW ngang tầm với các bộ lọc khác là được
question: Can optional Lost-track association reduce PF ID switches toward EKF without losing meaningful tracking quality?
primary_dataset: UA-DETRAC train dev12, 25 fps, YOLOv8n COCO c25, DETRAC-all, elapsed skip
secondary_dataset: BDD COCO-video val 200, 5 fps, YOLOv8n COCO c25, BDDCOCOVID-val, elapsed steps
decision_rule: Run all candidates on UA dev12. Only advance candidates with mean IDSW at least 10% below 697, HOTA no more than 0.5 percentage point below 57.006%, and IDF1 no more than 0.5 percentage point below R72. Run the best passing candidate on BDD; compare with PF R74 and EKF R61. Near EKF means IDSW <= 1.10x EKF on both datasets, with HOTA and IDF1 quality gates satisfied. If none passes, report failure and do not select a candidate.
evidence: Three seeds, paired video bootstrap 5000 replicates, raw TrackEval fields and cache/GT fingerprint checks; do not change detector, baseline tracker, evaluator, or default settings
interpretation: PF-specific association is an algorithm-level variant, not a motion-filter-only comparison. Reductions in IDSW accompanied by lower HOTA/IDF1 are not a success.
